items.answer: Two pure functions for the Watchlist POC: (1) rating notch calculator (REQ-06-02): previous + current rating -> notch change, direction, resulting WL. (2) Indicator 12 country rating change (REQ-03-12): previous + current rating -> WL 0, 1 or 2. Success = acceptance criteria met as corrected by C2/C3/C6, and the contract exports exist exactly as named.
items.quote: This job is a 2-requirement slice of that document. Build only these two requirements.

items.answer: The persona is the credit analyst who picks previous and current rating. Later POC screens call these functions and render the result. No roles/permissions: pure library functions.

items.answer: Yes, with C1-C8 applied. Scale index 0=AAA .. 18=CCC-; notchChange = index(current)-index(previous). notchChange('BBB+','BB+')=3; ('BB+','BBB+')=-3; ('AAA','CCC-')=18; ('A','A')=0. notchCalculator: BBB+->BB+ {notches:3,direction:'downgrade',wl:2}; BBB+->BBB- {2,'downgrade',1}; BBB+->BBB {1,'downgrade',0}; BB+->BBB+ {-3,'upgrade',0}; A->A {0,'unchanged',0}. countryRatingChangeWl: A->A- =1; A->BBB+ =2; AAA->CCC- =2; A-->A =0; A->A =0.

items.answer: Everything is a Must; the slice is the two requirements. countryRatingChangeWl is built on notchChange, so notch.mjs comes first.
items.quote: Build only these two requirements.

items.answer: src/ratings/notch.mjs: RATING_SCALE = the 19 C1 ratings, uppercase, best first. notchChange(previous,current) -> integer index(current)-index(previous), -18..18, positive = downgrade. notchCalculator(previous,current) -> {notches (same sign as notchChange, C5), direction 'downgrade'|'upgrade'|'unchanged', wl = 2 if notches>=3, 1 if notches==2, else 0}. src/indicators/countryRating.mjs: countryRatingChangeWl(previous,current) -> 2 if notchChange>=2, 1 if ==1, else 0; built on notchChange. Inputs are strings, trimmed (String.prototype.trim) and case-insensitive.
items.source: JOB.md Contract, C1, C2, C3, C5, C6
items.quote: direction: "downgrade" | "upgrade" | "unchanged"

items.answer: Every exported function throws RangeError if either argument does not match a C1 rating after trimming and case-folding: empty, whitespace-only, off-scale symbols ('D','NR','CC','Baa1'), internal spaces ('BBB +'), non-strings (null, undefined, numbers). No fallback or default WL. countryRatingChangeWl propagates notchChange's RangeError. Message text is not part of the contract.
items.quote: anything else is rejected with a RangeError
